name: qa-test-review
description: Test code review for test files only: conventions, isolation, object-model patterns, framework architecture audits, and test suite health checks. Includes a framework blueprint for new suites and a test design scorecard. Agents (test-code-critic, e2e-selector-quality-critic, framework-architecture-auditor, test-suite-health-auditor) review structure, assertions and mocking, selector fragility, framework architecture, and suite health. Production code is out of scope.
